Running it
----------
The game comes as the same Z88 application in three forms:

  simcity.epr     a card image (32 KB), for a slot: in the OZvm emulator,
                  insert the file as a card in a slot
  simcity.app     the installer's files: the .app file with the two banks,
  simcity.ap0     .ap0 and .ap1 (keep the three together, with the same
  simcity.ap1     name), to be installed from the Z88's RAM
  simcity.a5p     the same as one compressed file, for the OZ 5 installer

Once it is in the machine, SimCity appears in the Index.  Cities are
saved as files in the Z88's filing system: the game asks for a file name.

The game draws the map on the right of the screen and its text, icons
and the R, C and I bars in a window on the left.  It uses the OZ menus.

Keys
----
  Cursor keys     move the cursor one square (with shift: eight)
  O P Q A         left, right, up, down (shifted capitals: eight)
  Space, Enter    build with the tool
  Tab, Shift-Tab  the next, the previous tool (or , and . )
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map; Esc goes back to the city

The OZ menus (press the diamond, <>, then the letters):

  <> B            the budget
  <> E            the evaluation
  <> S            save the city
  <> L            load a city
  <> G N          a new city           <> G P   pause
  <> G Q          quit
  <> T F, N, L    speed: fast, normal, slow
  <> V ...        views: V C the city, V P pollution, V O police,
                  V F fire, V T traffic, V W power, V R transport,
                  V I crime, V X back to the city
  <> D ...        disasters: D F fire, D L flood, D E earthquake,
                  D A air crash, D T tornado, D M meltdown
  <> O ...        options: coal or nuclear power (O C, O N), disasters
                  (O D N, O D F), auto-bulldoze (O B N, O B F),
                  auto-budget (O A N, O A F), sound (O S N, O S F)

The menus also list all of these.  The tools that cost more than the
money you have are shown greyed out.  The budget and evaluation screens
close with Enter, Space or Esc.
